---
title: "Expanded Figure 1 and Supplementary Figure 2"
format: html
editor: source
---

Expansion of the archived community figure. A-D are embedded as
unchanged vector artwork; E-F show all six features passing either archived BH
test. No refits or additional feature filtering. Supplementary Figure 1 remains
reserved for experimental design and workflow.

Run with `bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/figure1_expanded_response.qmd NEW_OUTPUT`.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(patchwork)})
out <- commandArgs(TRUE)[1]
stopifnot(length(out)==1,!dir.exists(out))
root <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
frozen <- file.path(root,"figure1_shared_taxonomy_2026-09-14-v3")
response <- file.path(root,"figure2_response_2026-09-14-v2")
paths <- c(artwork=file.path(frozen,"figures/figure1-community-preview.pdf"),
 colours=file.path(frozen,"tables/MAG_colour_alignment.tsv"),
 trajectories=file.path(response,"selected_trajectories.tsv"),
 tests=file.path(response,"all_tested_features.tsv"),
 viral_taxonomy=file.path(root,"votu_taxonomic_resolution_review_2026-09-13-v4/tables/catalogue_rank_assignments.tsv"))
hash <- function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
before <- vapply(paths,hash,character(1))
inventory <- fread(file.path(frozen,"output_sha256.tsv"))
stopifnot(all(vapply(file.path(frozen,inventory$path),hash,character(1))==inventory$sha256))
z <- fread(paths['trajectories']);a <- fread(paths['tests']);key <- fread(paths['colours'])
vt <- fread(paths['viral_taxonomy'])
selected <- a[(!is.na(main_q)&main_q<.05)|(!is.na(interaction_q)&interaction_q<.05),feature_id]
stopifnot(setequal(selected,unique(z$feature_id)),uniqueN(z$feature_id)==6,
 nrow(z)==72,!anyDuplicated(z[,.(feature_id,sample_title)]),all(is.finite(z$normalized_count)),all(z$normalized_count>=0))
z[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("control","treatment"))]
z[,phase:=factor(phase,levels=c("initial","backflush"))]
ids <- unique(z[,.(feature_id,community,main_q,interaction_q)])
ids[,`:=`(taxonomy="Taxonomy unavailable in reviewed catalogue",marker="#D5D9DD")]
for(i in seq_len(nrow(ids))) {
 id <- ids$feature_id[i]
 if(ids$community[i]=="MAGs") {
   k <- key[MAG_ID==id];stopifnot(nrow(k)==1)
   ids[i,`:=`(taxonomy=k$deepest,marker=k$colour)]
 } else {
   k <- vt[contig_id==id]
   if(nrow(k)==1)for(r in c("realm","kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","subfamily","genus","species"))
     if(!is.na(k[[r]])&&nzchar(k[[r]]))ids$taxonomy[i] <- paste0(r,": ",k[[r]])
 }
}
col <- c(control="#8FCB8A",treatment="#7E57C2")
one <- function(id) {
 d <- z[feature_id==id];k<-ids[feature_id==id]
 short <- if(k$community=="MAGs")sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_"," / MAG ",id) else sub("_coassembly_megahit_.*_contig_k141_"," / vOTU ",id)
 ggplot(d,aes(cycle,normalized_count,colour=condition,shape=phase,linetype=phase,
   group=interaction(condition,phase)))+
 geom_line(linewidth=.6)+geom_point(size=2.3)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=col,labels=c("Control","Phage-UV"),name=NULL)+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(initial=16,backflush=17),name=NULL)+
 scale_linetype_manual(values=c(initial="solid",backflush="dashed"),name=NULL)+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:3)+scale_y_continuous(trans=scales::pseudo_log_trans(base=10),labels=scales::label_number())+
 labs(title=paste(short,k$taxonomy,sep="\n"),
 subtitle=sprintf("Condition q=%.3g; interaction q=%.3g",k$main_q,k$interaction_q),
 x="Cleaning cycle",y="Normalized mapped reads")+
 theme_classic(base_size=11)+theme(plot.title=element_text(size=11),
 plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9),legend.position="bottom",plot.margin=margin(10,12,6,12),
 axis.line.x=element_line(colour=if(k$community=="MAGs")k$marker else "#30343A",linewidth=1.5))
}
# A taxonomy-coloured header rule on each MAG chart matches the frozen key.
# Condition remains the line colour; viral charts have neutral taxonomy markers.
magids <- ids[community=="MAGs",feature_id];virusids<-ids[community=="vOTUs",feature_id]
stopifnot(length(magids)==2,length(virusids)==4)
strip <- wrap_plots(lapply(c(magids,virusids),one),ncol=1,guides="collect")+
 plot_annotation(tag_levels=list(c("E","","F","","",""))) &
 theme(legend.position="bottom",plot.tag=element_text(size=16),plot.tag.position="topleft")
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(out,"tables"));dir.create(file.path(out,"source"))
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/trajectory-column.pdf"),strip,width=6.5,height=22,device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE)
# Lossless vector composition. The approved A-D artwork is never overwritten.
compose <- paste(
 "import sys",
 "from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter, Transformation",
 "a,b,d=sys.argv[1:]",
 "w=PdfWriter(); p=w.add_blank_page(width=22.5*72,height=22*72)",
 "p.merge_page(PdfReader(a).pages[0])",
 "p.merge_transformed_page(PdfReader(b).pages[0],Transformation().translate(tx=16*72,ty=0))",
 "w.write(d)",sep="\n")
stopifnot(system2("python3",c("-c",shQuote(compose),shQuote(paths['artwork']),
 shQuote(file.path(out,"figures/trajectory-column.pdf")),shQuote(file.path(out,"figures/figure1-expanded.pdf"))))==0)
a[,`:=`(log_main=-log10(pmax(main_q,1e-300)),log_interaction=-log10(pmax(interaction_q,1e-300)))]
overview <- ggplot(a,aes(log_main,log_interaction))+
 geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(.05),linetype=2,colour="grey60")+
 geom_vline(xintercept=-log10(.05),linetype=2,colour="grey60")+
 geom_point(aes(shape=supported),colour="#375568",size=2,alpha=.65)+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(`FALSE`=1,`TRUE`=16),guide="none")+
 facet_wrap(~community,nrow=1)+theme_classic(base_size=12)+
 labs(title="Supplementary Figure 2 | Community differential-abundance overview",
 x="Condition association (-log10 adjusted p)",y="Condition-by-cycle interaction (-log10 adjusted p)",
 caption="Dashed thresholds: BH q = 0.05. Filled points pass either test.\nAll tested features retained in source tables; unavailable q values cannot be positioned.")
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/supplementary-figure2.pdf"),overview,width=12,height=5.5,device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE)
fwrite(a,file.path(out,"tables/all_tested_features.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(z,file.path(out,"tables/selected_trajectories.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(ids,file.path(out,"tables/trajectory_labels_and_colours.tsv"),sep="\t")
model_dir <- file.path(root,"community_cycle_models_2026-09-13-v1/tables")
model_files <- file.path(model_dir,as.vector(outer(c("mag","votu"),c("_main_wald.tsv","_interaction_lrt.tsv"),paste0)))
stopifnot(all(file.copy(model_files,file.path(out,"tables"))));paths<-c(paths,model_files)
writeLines(c(readLines(file.path(frozen,"FIGURE_LEGEND_DRAFT.txt")),
 "E-F: All two MAGs and four vOTUs passing the main-condition or joint-interaction BH q<0.05 threshold. Individual points represent 12 observed samples per feature; connecting lines are not fitted curves. Separate pseudo-log y scales. Green/purple denote control/Phage-UV; circles/solid initial and triangles/dashed backflush. MAG axis accent matches frozen taxonomy key. No assertion that the displayed MAGs and vOTUs form linked pairs.",
 "Models: main phase+cycle+condition; interaction LRT phase+cycle*condition versus phase+cycle+condition. One membrane per condition; not replicated causal treatment inference.",
 "Supplementary Figure 1 remains experimental design/workflow. Supplementary Figure 2 contains the full differential-abundance overview; complete results accompany it in tables/."),file.path(out,"FIGURE_LEGEND_DRAFT.txt"))
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"),file.path(out,"source/figure1_expanded_response.qmd"))
stopifnot(identical(before,vapply(paths[seq_along(before)],hash,character(1))))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=vapply(paths,hash,character(1))),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
files<-list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
cat("PASS: frozen A-D unchanged; 6 selected features; 72 observations; MAG colours matched; S1 reserved\n")
```
